capabilities: Show a floating overlay while sync is running
Display a completion notice that hides after 5 seconds or stays visible
Distinguish checking, paused, disconnected, error, and unrecognized states
Switch to a 30px icon-only overlay with rotating spinner and status icons
Limit automatic notices to the first sync after launch
disambiguation: Does not sync files itself; it only displays the status reported by the official Sync core plugin.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It relies on undocumented internal APIs (app.internalPlugins, getStatus, status-change/new-log events) that may break in future Obsidian versions, and mobile behavior has not been verified on real Android/iOS devices. Manual installation from GitHub Releases is required.
intentEvidence: 为官方 Obsidian Sync 增加电脑、Android、iOS 都可显示的中文浮窗
problem: Obsidian Sync has no clear, persistent on-screen indicator of sync status, so users can start editing before syncing finishes, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: 需要开启官方核心插件 Sync 并连接远程仓库

requires.name: Official Sync core plugin with a connected remote vault

summary: Floating status window that shows the official Obsidian Sync progress, completion, and error states on desktop and mobile.
